study: Development-only automatic meaning-plan composition; identical private pinned Qwen3.6 Q8 model
motivation: Recommended and greedy direct conditions failed the frozen gate. Greedy D02 explicitly inverted the no-delivery constraint; correctness did not follow from deterministic decoding.
data: Four previously exposed dev.json cases only; no held-out output generated
steps: Generate JSON facts, required message acts and negative constraints from the original situation/relationship/goal only
Validate JSON structure without asserting semantic correctness
Generate a Saudi message with the frozen few-shot policy, original input and the automatic plan as advisory data; original input remains authoritative
sampler: Existing greedy endpoint: temperature 0, presence penalty 0, repetition penalty 1, max_tokens 256, seed 3407, thinking disabled for both steps
acceptance: All four final messages must be strictly sendable under protocol.json; assess plans separately and preserve incorrect plans. No replacement, cleanup or hand-editing of model outputs.
fresh_test: Remains unopened unless this method meets raw development and actual full-pipeline 4/4 gates, then the original 13/16 and application gates apply unchanged.
reviewer: Assistant only; independent human Saudi Arabic review pending
